neighbours.label: The words ' shades', ' tones' and ' rays' and Russian 'оттенки' when about colour or light (peak on the noun or the following ' of'); the same words about something else stay low. Word-level: other words for colour or light are not tested.
fire: The walls were painted in warm shades of grey.
She mixed soft tones of blue on the canvas.
Bright rays fell across the wet hillside.
В интерьере преобладают светлые оттенки зелёного.
The sky turned deep shades of violet at dusk.
Earthy tones of ochre fill the old fresco.
Slanting rays lit the far side of the barn.
quiet: The walls were painted before the winter.
She mixed soft dough for bread on the counter.
Stinging rays hid along the far side of the bay.
В его голосе слышны тёплые оттенки грусти.
He lost his shades at the pool at dusk.
Angry tones of voice fill the old office.
Slanting roofs lined the far side of the barn.
Художник любил тёплые вечера в деревне.

short: ' shades', ' tones', ' rays' of colour or light
notes: Probes: 0.75-1.14 for shades, tones, rays and 'оттенки', and 'rays of' 0.48. 'His shades were on the table' 0.11, 'tone of her letter' 0.02, 'rows of houses' 0.13. ' rich' read 0.50 even in 'rich people', a separate leak this test leaves out. Spanish 'tonos' read 0.21 with or without colour, and 'nuances' 0.10, so those are not covered.
